answer: Start with Signed neighbourhood watch membership with police community attestation. The idea is simple: a membership the police kept across years of patrols, and that oasis alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a membership the police kept across years of patrols — so privacy survives, and the tundra is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ivory for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
